card.name: Digits inside multi-digit dose numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a number, such as the 0 in 10 or the 5 in 150, in dose, activity or amount figures. The next token is usually another digit or a decimal point, not a full stop.

modes.label: Digit inside dose figure
modes.description: A digit partway through a dose or radioactivity amount, with more digits to follow.
modes.example: The usual starting dose is Irbesartan and Hydrochlorothiazide Tablets 1<<5>>0/12.5 mg once

modes.label: Digit in unit conversion or range
modes.description: A digit in a converted or ranged value, like mCi against MBq or a dose range.

card.writes: It suppresses full stops and sentence-ending punctuation, so the number is expected to continue rather than end.
card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a number, where the number is still going and has not ended.
